items.title: Archie Martin Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: I used to be in all them things when I had some money... Oh I, uh, Zulus.

ctx.x: Mmhmm. Eclipse Aiden Pleasure Club. Frogs. I used to be back at the National Park on Willow in Thuid. I belong to the, used to belong to the bulls. I used to belong to the money wasters. The original spokes. Oh I, uh, Zulus. Yeah Tammany. I used to be in all them things when I had some money. And none of them I didn't used to belong to because I was always in the ballroom business and that made you belong to them because they helped you out. But at that time I had money then. I ain't got no money to take care of…
Well some of them went down huh?
